card.name: Speed limits on dose or correction increases
card.fires_on: Words and numbers right where a limit on how fast something may rise is being set, such as 'no more rapidly than', 'by more than', 'increased per week', or 'too rapid correction'. Seen in dose titration and sodium correction instructions.

modes.label: Rate of correction
modes.description: Position just before or in a numeric cap on how quickly sodium is raised.
modes.example: serum sodium should not be elevated by more than<< >>10 mEq/L to 1

modes.label: Titration pace
modes.description: Words about the pace or interval of dose increases, such as week, weekly, rapidly, pace.
modes.example: Titrate at<< weekly>> intervals by 6 mg per day based

modes.label: Too rapid correction
modes.description: The noun or number following 'too rapid' in a sodium correction warning.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward speed words like rapid, rapidly, quicker and hurry.
card.plain: It lights up where a label sets how fast a dose or lab value may be raised.
